The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency

The monitoring is ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
The monitoring is clinically necessary to evaluate intermittent palpitations and dyspnea
The monitoring addresses the documented diagnosis and guides ongoing management of the cardiac condition
